description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nikahena, Medirigiriya D/S DIvision, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120083
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership status (all listed as "State" owned), and other land registration particulars. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
